title: Inception
description: A thief who steals secrets through dream-sharing technology is hired to plant an idea in a target's mind. A mind-bending heist thriller directed by Christopher Nolan.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: Two imprisoned men bond over several years, finding solace and eventual redemption through acts of common decency. A moving, hopeful prison drama.

title: Spirited Away
description: A young girl wanders into a world of spirits and must work in a bathhouse to free her parents. A magical, visually stunning animated fantasy by Hayao Miyazaki.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman faces the anarchic Joker, who plunges Gotham City into chaos. A gritty, intense superhero crime thriller.

title: Parasite
description: A poor family schemes to become employed by a wealthy household, with darkly comic and shocking consequences. A sharp social thriller from Bong Joon-ho.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: A legendary concierge and his lobby boy get caught up in the theft of a priceless painting. A quirky, colorful comedy by Wes Anderson.

title: Interstellar
description: Explorers travel through a wormhole near Saturn to find a new home for humanity. An emotional, epic space adventure about love and time.

title: Whiplash
description: A young jazz drummer is pushed to the edge by an abusive, perfectionist instructor. An intense drama about ambition and sacrifice.

title: Toy Story
description: A cowboy doll feels threatened when a new spaceman action figure becomes his owner's favorite toy. A heartwarming, funny family animation, the first fully computer-animated feature.

title: Get Out
description: A Black photographer visits his white girlfriend's family estate and uncovers a disturbing secret. A smart, tense horror film with sharp social commentary.

title: La La Land
description: An aspiring actress and a jazz pianist fall in love while chasing their dreams in Los Angeles. A romantic, bittersweet musical.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: In a desert wasteland, a drifter and a rebel warrior flee a tyrant in a relentless high-speed chase. A pure adrenaline action spectacle.

title: The Godfather
description: The aging patriarch of a crime dynasty transfers control to his reluctant son. A landmark crime drama about family, power and loyalty.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
description: A laundromat owner is pulled into a multiverse adventure to save the world. A wildly inventive, funny and emotional sci-fi comedy about family.

title: Superbad
description: Two high school friends try to buy alcohol for a party before graduation. A raunchy, hilarious coming-of-age comedy.
